desc:
Welcome to +1 Sandworm Evolution 🐛

🍖 Bite and eat to gain Power!
🏜️ Dig in the Sand Pits to grow even faster
⚔️ Hunt enemies and clear stages
🚧 Devour every enemy to smash the gate to the next stage
🏆 Earn Wins and spend them on bigger Sandworm Evolutions
🥚 Hatch sand pets to multiply your Power
👹 Swallow giant bosses
⚡ Rebirth to become even stronger
🎁 Free rewards just for playing

🔥 Burrow, bite, evolve, and become the biggest sandworm in the desert!

👍 Every like goal gives everyone online a free pet! Like the game to reach the goal!
